BAFTA on Instagram: "A touching moment as Paul Thomas Anderson takes home the Director award for One Battle After Another ❤️⁣
⁣
#EEBAFTAs #OneBattleAfterAnother #PaulThomasAnderson"
content.text: Never miss a post from baftaSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Well deserved, but he should have won many years ago for There Will Be Blood.Baffling is the popularity of this odd film.PTA highlighting Sarah and Adam shows what type of human being he is. Perfect speech 🎤Yes congratulations to Leo personally as he also really put this movie on the map in a big way!!! He made the writing & directing pop out at you!A moving speech and great tribute to his friend. PTA is long overdue but also he truly deserves this. Congrats to him and can’t wait to see him hold his first Oscar next month 🙌Somner was the GREATEST! Nobody could keep the show on the road and do it with grace and style, and keep morale and inspiration at the forefront more so than he did.An incredible film deserving of all its accolades.Interesting how you guys didn't post del Rio lindo and Michael B Jordan's speech.... I wonder whyI know he's an amazing filmmaker and I lover several of his films, but I can never forget he threw Fiona Apple out of a car plus many other stories about him as a person. Ryan Coogler and Chloe Zhao would NEVERPTA is a filmmaking legend and seems like a great guy, too. His 2015 interview with Marc Maron on WFT pod is brilliant 🙌Classy. Inspiring 🫶🙏🏻👏👏Comment thread know NOTHINGS we don't care
